For Suppliers

Bring useful products closer to the people who need them.

Connect Your Products with the Care Community

WeMall creates a digital connection between suppliers and the people, families, care teams and organisations looking for products to support independence, safety, wellbeing and better everyday living.

More than a product marketplace, WeMall forms part of the wider WeAIT ecosystem, helping connect product discovery, information, quotations and purchasing with the broader care journey.

Become a Supplier

Join WeMall and make your products more accessible to the care community.

We welcome suppliers offering relevant, reliable products and solutions that support aged care, disability support, independence, safety, mobility, wellbeing and everyday living.

Our supplier onboarding process helps establish your business profile, product information and the information required to participate in the WeMall marketplace.

Become a WeMall Supplier

Supplier Benefits

WeMall gives suppliers a new way to connect with customers and the wider care ecosystem.

Suppliers can showcase products to individuals, families, care teams and organisations, provide clearer product and quotation information, and participate in connected purchasing workflows designed to reduce unnecessary administrative steps.

Being part of WeMall also creates opportunities for suppliers to participate within the broader WeAIT connected care ecosystem.

Product Listing Standards

Clear and accurate information supports better purchasing decisions.

Products listed on WeMall should include appropriate descriptions, specifications, pricing and other relevant information such as images, warranty details, delivery information and supporting documentation where applicable.

Where a product requires professional assessment, prescription, installation or other conditions of supply, these requirements should be clearly identified.

Supplier Pricing

WeMall is designed to promote transparent purchasing and informed customer choice.

Suppliers are responsible for maintaining accurate and current pricing and clearly identifying relevant product, delivery, installation or other applicable charges.

Where quotations are required, suppliers should provide sufficient information to support customers and care teams in understanding the proposed purchase.

Supplier Portal

The WeMall Supplier Portal provides a central place for suppliers to manage their participation in the marketplace.

Depending on the supplier’s access and available functionality, the portal supports the management of supplier and product information and relevant purchasing activities, helping keep information accurate, organised and easier to manage.

Supplier Terms

All WeMall suppliers are expected to meet applicable supplier requirements and agreed terms relating to product information, pricing, service delivery, privacy, confidentiality and responsible marketplace participation.

These expectations help maintain a trusted marketplace where customers, care teams and suppliers can engage with greater confidence.

Connected Through UniHub

Through UniHub, relevant supplier, product and transaction information can be connected across authorised parts of the WeAIT ecosystem, reducing duplication and supporting more accurate, efficient data management, utilisation and monitoring.

Grow with the WeAIT Ecosystem

Becoming part of WeMall is more than simply listing products. It provides an opportunity to participate in a connected care ecosystem designed around people, choice, collaboration and better care outcomes.

Connect your products. Reach the care community. Grow through a smarter care ecosystem.
